title: Tankless Water Heaters Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Manufactured by Daesung Celtic Enersys; Distributed Exclusively by Challenger Supply Holdings
summary: The water heaters can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 29,000 in the United States and 2,200 in Canada.

title: Venmar Ventilation Expands Recall of Air Exchangers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The motor in the air exchangers can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 108,000 in the United States (an additional 77,500 previously recalled in March 2007, December 2007 and June 2011) and about 207,000 in Canada..

title: Ventamatic Recalls Cool Draft Misting Fans Due to Risk of Fire and Electric Shock
summary: The fan's wiring is not properly grounded, posing electric shock and fire hazards. Units: About 450.

title: Aqua Lung Expands Recall of Buoyancy Compensators Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The rubber handles can detach as divers are trying to remove the weight pockets to rise to the surface in an emergency. This poses a drowning hazard. Units: About 30,000 in the United States and 11,300 in Canada (an additional 110,000 were previously recalled in the U.S. in March 2013).

title: McDonald's Recalls Hello Kitty Themed Whistles Due to Choking and Aspiration Hazards
summary: Components inside of the whistle can detach, posing choking and aspiration hazards to young children. Units: About 2.3 million in the U.S. In addition, about 200,000 were distributed in Canada..

title: Folding Lounge Chairs Recalled by 4Seasons Due to Fall Hazard; Sold exclusively at Ross Stores
summary: The chair can tip or recline too quickly, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,200.

title: Goal Zero Recalls Battery Packs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery packs can overcharge, overheat, bulge and melt the battery pack's enclosure, posing a fire hazard and risk of property damage. Units: About 10,000 in the U.S. and 110 in Canada.

title: Pro Armor Recalls Doors for Polaris RZR 800 and 900 Utility Vehicles Due to Impact, Laceration Hazards
summary: The latch pin can disengage from the latch and allow the door to open while the vehicle is moving, posing a risk of ejection of an unrestrained rider and impact or laceration hazards. Units: About 300.

title: Bob-Cat Recalls Zero Turn Mowers Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steering control arm component can break under normal use, causing driver to lose control and crash. Units: About 4,900.

title: Graco Recalls 11 Models of Strollers Due to Fingertip Amputation Hazard
summary: The folding hinge on the sides of the stroller can pinch a child's finger, posing a laceration or amputation hazard. Units: About 4.7 million in United States, about 202,000 in Canada, and about 10,300 in Mexico.

title: Leatherman Recalls Children's Multi-Tool Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The lock mechanism on the optional knife blade can inadvertently release the blade, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 8,000 in the U.S. and 400 in Canada.

title: Tyco Fire Protection Recalls Simplex Fire Alarm Control Panels Due to Failure to Activate (Recall Alert)
summary: A defective chip in the alarm panel can cause premature battery failure and prevent activation of devices during alarm conditions, posing a risk of injury and property damage. Units: About 750.

title: AP Specialties Recalls Power Bank Chargers
summary: When unit is being charged or being used to charge another device, it can overheat, causing a fire hazard. Units: About 172,000.

title: Hoppe's Recalls Semi-Auto Bore Cleaner Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: Bottles have a child-resistant cap that can become loose. Chemicals in this product can cause skin irritation, internal injury or death if ingested. Units: About 110,000.

title: Mohawk Recalls Rugs Due To Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at The Home Depot
summary: The large rugs fail to meet federal standards for flammability and could ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. The small rugs fail to meet federal labeling requirements. title: Olympus Recalls Digital Audio Recorders Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled recorders can overheat when charging, posing a burn hazard to consumers and property. Units: About 500.

title: Black Diamond Equipment Recalls Whippet Ski Poles Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The stainless steel pick in the handgrip can break and fail to slow or stop users from sliding downhill on a snow or ice covered slope, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 3,000..

title: CoScentrix Expands Recall of DD Brand Candles Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Hobby Lobby
summary: The candles' high flame can ignite the surface of the wax, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 256,000 (about 126,000 candles sold in tins were previously recalled in April 2014)..
